summary: A friendly cat named Rattles loves being around people on the farm. When Linda and Michelle visit Grandma, they learn all about Rattles and her kitten litter.

chunks.verbatim_page_text: Rattles loved humans. When Uncle Duane milked the cows, Rattles would jump onto his lap. When Grandma fed the calves, Rattles would follow her. And when Grandma went for a walk, Rattles would jump on her shoulder, ride along, and purr a purr so big she sounded like a rattle. Rattles was different. One day two children arrived on the farm. Their names were Linda and Michelle, and they had come to visit Grandma. “Kitties!” shouted Linda as she crawled out of the van. “Grandma, do you have any new baby kittens?” “I sure do,” smiled Grandma. “There’s a litter of four kittens in the haymow. They’re all wild though – all of them except one that is.” That one was Rattles, of course. Rattles was different.
chunks.lookout_prompt: Before you read, watch for how Rattles sounds when she purrs.
chunks.checkin_question: Why was the kitten named Rattles?
chunks.target_answer_concept: She purred so big she sounded like a rattle.
acceptable_phrasings: Because her purr was so big she sounded like a rattle.
She purred really loud and sounded just like a rattle.
